title: Affine derived pushforward reflects isomorphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], if a morphism $u:E\to F$ has derived direct image $Rf_*u$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] an isomorphism, then $u$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: For an affine morphism, [lem-sc-finite-affine-derived-equivalence] gives an equivalence $\Phi:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\simeq D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ whose composite with restriction of scalars to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ is $Rf_*$. Restriction of scalars reflects isomorphisms: the cone of a morphism of $f_*\mathcal O_X$-complexes is acyclic exactly when its underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-complex is acyclic, since the underlying complexes and cohomology groups are unchanged. Thus, if $Rf_*u$ is an isomorphism, then $\Phi(u)$ is an isomorphism.

An equivalence reflects isomorphisms: applying a quasi-inverse to the isomorphism of $\Phi(u)$ obtained in Step 1, and using the unit and counit isomorphisms, gives an inverse to $u$. Therefore $Rf_*$ reflects isomorphisms on $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$.
